name: unresolved-category-per-name-first-wins
body: EdgeEmitter.EmitUnresolvedNode writes one unresolved record per target name for the whole scan, so the first compilation to emit a name sets its category: in a multi-project scan, a name bound in one compilation (stdlib/external) and unbound in another (unknown) carries only the first compilation's category, depending on compilation order. Upgrade to per-reference categories if any consumer needs a shared name's category per compilation.
